tables.name: checkpoint
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE checkpoint (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1), position INTEGER NOT NULL, byte_length INTEGER NOT NULL, chunk_count INTEGER NOT NULL, digest TEXT NOT NULL)

tables.name: checkpoint_chunks
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE checkpoint_chunks (ordinal INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (ordinal >= 0), payload BLOB NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(payload) = 'blob' AND length(payload) > 0))

tables.name: checkpoint_trees
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE checkpoint_trees (actor TEXT PRIMARY KEY, position INTEGER NOT NULL, commits INTEGER NOT NULL) WITHOUT ROWID

tables.name: effect_input_chunks
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE effect_input_chunks (actor TEXT NOT NULL, ref TEXT NOT NULL, ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL, payload BLOB NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (actor, ref, ordinal)) WITHOUT ROWID

tables.name: effect_inputs
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE effect_inputs (actor TEXT NOT NULL, ref TEXT NOT NULL, byte_length INTEGER NOT NULL, chunk_count INTEGER NOT NULL, digest TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (actor, ref)) WITHOUT ROWID

tables.name: experimental_event_chunks
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE experimental_event_chunks (actor TEXT NOT NULL, seq INTEGER NOT NULL, ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL, payload BLOB NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (actor, seq, ordinal), FOREIGN KEY (actor, seq) REFERENCES experimental_events(actor, seq)) WITHOUT ROWID

tables.name: experimental_events
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE experimental_events (actor TEXT NOT NULL, seq INTEGER NOT NULL, event TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (actor, seq)) WITHOUT ROWID

tables.name: experimental_messages
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE experimental_messages (actor TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL, seq INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (actor, id), FOREIGN KEY (actor, seq) REFERENCES experimental_events(actor, seq)) WITHOUT ROWID

tables.name: grove_chunks
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE grove_chunks (hash TEXT NOT NULL, ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL, payload BLOB NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (hash, ordinal)) WITHOUT ROWID

tables.name: grove_nodes
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE grove_nodes (hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY, byte_length INTEGER NOT NULL, chunk_count INTEGER NOT NULL, children BLOB NOT NULL, payload BLOB) WITHOUT ROWID

tables.name: grove_owners
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE grove_owners (name TEXT PRIMARY KEY, root TEXT NOT NULL) WITHOUT ROWID

indexes.name: experimental_thread_versions
indexes.sql: CREATE INDEX experimental_thread_versions ON experimental_events (actor, seq DESC) WHERE json_extract(event, '$.event.type') IN ('ThreadCreated', 'ThreadUpdated')
